Module com.example.cab302_project_pomodora
Package com.qut.cab302_project_pomodora.model

Class Timer

java.lang.Object
com.qut.cab302_project_pomodora.model.Timer
public class Timer extends Object
Timer class represents a timer with work duration, short break duration, long break duration, and the number of work sessions before a long break.
